question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` be accepted as a stable generic public plugin-SDK reply contract?
rationale: The patch is functionally coherent, but repository policy treats new plugin API surface as compatibility-sensitive and no maintainer review or discussion confirms this permanent boundary.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive typed intent, document its stable producer and channel semantics as needed, and merge after exact-head Slack proof.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Replace the public export with an internal or plugin-local seam while retaining the same typed-only Slack behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive typed intent, document its stable producer and channel semantics as needed, and merge after exact-head Slack proof.
